note: Each entry names one case that skips on every job of the test matrix, and the reason that stops it. tests/skip_gate.py reads this file and it fails an entry that names no reason. Repair a case rather than add an entry, unless a runner can never hold the condition the case needs. An entry that records an open finding names the issue that removes it. The census of #524 measured every entry below on 2026-08-10, in run https://github.com/Crank-Git/ja4plus/actions/runs/31408763259.

entries.reason: The case reads `gh api repos/Crank-Git/ja4plus/branches/dev/protection`, and the provider grants that read to a repository administrator alone.
